name: Rhys Griffiths
bio:
Rhys Griffiths' journey into motorsport data analysis began unconventionally, stemming from a lifelong fascination with statistics and complex systems. After completing his degree in Applied Mathematics, he found himself drawn to the intricate world of Formula 1, specifically the challenge of extracting meaningful insights from vast datasets. His early career involved analyzing financial markets, but the allure of motorsport proved too strong to resist.

He joined Stake Sauber three years ago, quickly establishing himself as a key asset in the team's data analysis department. Rhys' approach is methodical and detail-oriented, driven by a desire to uncover hidden performance gains. He believes in the power of data to inform strategic decisions and consistently seeks to improve the team's understanding of car dynamics and driver performance. His calm demeanor and ability to remain focused under pressure have earned him the respect of his colleagues. What sets him apart is his ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for the engineers and strategists.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on his desk when deep in thought.
Insists on using only a specific brand of blue ink for his notes.
